newsitem.title: USA: Speedway offers $23 cash for each north carol.
newsitem.headline: Speedway offers $23 cash for each north carol.

text.p: Speedway Motorsports Inc proposed a merger with North Carolina Motor Speedway Inc Wednesday, offering shareholders $23, cash, or one share of Speedway for one share of NCMS.
The company made the offer in a letter to NCMS's board of directors.

Speedway said the offer was an alternative to a proposal earlier this week by Penske Motorsports Inc to buy NCMS. The Penske offer would pay NCMS shareholders either $14 a share, cash, or Penske stock, the number of share of which would be determined by a complicated fomula.
Penske has said it entered into a definitive option and voting agreement with the owner of 65 percent of NCMS stock.
No further details were available about either offer.
